images.prompt: Create a realistic premium editorial photo for a technology training homepage. A diverse small group of adult learners and a mentor are gathered around laptops in a bright modern classroom, reviewing business intelligence dashboards and data charts on screens. The mood is focused, ambitious, professional and welcoming. Use warm daylight, clean desks, subtle magenta accent objects, graphite and white interior, shallow depth of field. Leave natural negative space on the left side for website headline placement. No visible brand logos, no readable text, no watermark.
images.negative_prompt: No cartoon style, no 3D render, no neon cyberpunk, no exaggerated purple lighting, no fake text on screens, no distorted faces or hands, no clutter.

images.prompt: Create a realistic square editorial portrait scene for a professional tech training center. A confident mentor explains data analytics concepts to two adult learners at a clean desk with laptops and notebooks. The setting is a modern Tunis business training room, bright and minimal, with warm daylight and subtle magenta accent details. Professional, trustworthy, human, not posed like stock photography. No logos, no readable text.
images.negative_prompt: No cartoon, no over-smiling stock photo look, no fake typography, no watermark, no messy cables, no distorted hands.

images.prompt: Create a realistic professional photo for a corporate training offer. A small enterprise team is in a modern meeting room, collaborating with a trainer on a data strategy workshop.
